services.name: SkydiveCT
services.desc: Student training at Connecticut Parachutists is designed with one goal in mind: to help you earn your USPA “A” License. All unlicensed skydivers are required to complete the entire student training program before they skydive with other jumpers. It takes a minimum of 25 jumps to obtain your license. Make your reservations early; classes are limited. Classes are held regardless of the weather. The program begins with a 6-8 hour ground class with a limited enrollment of only 6 students. The class will build your confidence, increase your understanding of skydiving, introduce you to the equipment, and prepare you for your first solo skydive.
